$comment: Per-repo settings read by the sydevs `workflow` plugin. Replaces the 'Intentional per-repo deltas' table that used to live in three hand-synced copies of .claude/docs/workflow-parity.md.

contractStep.description: Consume the generated types from SahajCloud main. No migrations here.

securityReview.rationale: Server-side rendering, preview routes, and the deploy/build configuration.

worktreeNotes: Copy .env / .dev.vars from the main checkout if the branch needs them.

generatedFiles.reason: `server/payload-types.ts` is generated by `pnpm types:cms` (it curls the schema from SahajCloud main and strips the module augmentation). Do not hand-edit it. To change CMS types the upstream schema must change and be merged first — see /cross-repo-issue. For app-specific types use `server/cms-types.ts`.
`dist/` is build output from `pnpm build`. Change the source and rebuild.
`pnpm-lock.yaml` is generated by pnpm. Use `pnpm add` / `pnpm remove` / `pnpm update`.
